## 5. Things worth your attention

**The low-yield warnings are real but explainable** (notes §9): 17/67 and 14/92 `included`. Counting `inline` and `already-published`, coverage is 26/67 and 52/92 — the gap on 401 is Zhao's regularity chapter, which the library published in full at order 399. Every `deferred` row names a destination that resolves, mostly to pages inside the same 393–442 block.

**The boundary worksheet caught me.** My first contract draft used one shared boundary block across the example items and several shared one-line rationales. `boundary-audit` flagged all of it; rewriting per item is where the sharpest facts got pinned down — that a ≤2-vertex set is 0-restricted, that self-density never reaches 1, that the dense trimming loses 2γ and the sparse only γ, and that the covering iteration needs the logarithmic step bound, not the linear one.

**Not verified**: harvest faithfulness (yours at step 6); the Alon–Pach–Solymosi original (paywalled — statement taken from two agreeing secondary sources, proof follows Chudnovsky's sketch); Nikiforov's own paper (arXiv PDF 500s on every variant, no Wayback snapshot — Fox–Sudakov state the *stronger* partition form, the target paper the single-set form, and this page proves the latter and says so).
